description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to web requests in a websocket context, including request parsing, serialization, MIME types, and authorization.

classes.name: IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response body serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with hash type and value.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents HTTP authorization with type and token.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket request with parsing, serialization, and various request parameters.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type and encoding for a given file path.

methods.description: Serializes a Request object into a string.
